/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, urllib.request
p=pathlib.Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/Oneiro/bridge-token'
req=urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8765/call', data=json.dumps({'tool':'get_app_state','arguments':{'app':'Simulator'}}).encode(), headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+p.read_text().strip(),'Content-Type':'application/json'})
print(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read()[:400])
PY"
